counterThresholds.note: Fourteen needles: its Strikes lose all runes.

description.value:
Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Scarlet Needle], by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Place a Scarlet Needle], by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Crimson Flurry], and by both Scorpio skies.

The badge counts the needles currently in this creature. That is the whole tracker: needles are per-creature by definition, and every creature carries its own.

The count crosses three thresholds by itself, once each: at 5 the creature is enfeebled 1, at 10 it is blinded, and at 14 it is stunned 2 and its Strikes lose all runes.

Scorpio's Techniques read the count too: 5 needles is the requirement for @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Antares], @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Crimson Mirage] deals its mental damage per needle, and the Ascendant bleed is 1d6 a needle to a maximum of ten.

The needles last until the encounter ends, which is what the Cloth says; a full rest clears them too, and outside an encounter the effect can be removed by hand.
